sources.title: GitHub - ttlmtang123/Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct: The Phi-3-Mini-4K-Instruct ...
sources.snippet: The model belongs to the Phi-3 family with the Mini version in two variants 4K and 128K which is the context length (in tokens) that it can support. The model has underwent a post-training process that incorporates both supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization for the instruction following and safety measures.

sources.title: microsoft/phi-3-mini-4k-instruct | Readme and Docs
sources.snippet: The Phi-3-Mini-4K-Instruct is a 3.8B parameters, lightweight, state-of-the-art open model trained with the Phi-3 datasets that includes both synthetic data and the filtered publicly available websites data with a focus on high-quality and reasoning dense properties.
